acceptance.correctness: Fresh weighted model, exact compact/unrestricted physical responses, independent numeric gap at most 1e-10, positive mass support and unchanged own-hand information.
acceptance.failure: Preserve partial report files, original traceback and source snapshots; stop on first execution/correctness/source error, mark later calls not-run.
acceptance.interpretation: Finite fixed-support games only; no unrestricted NLHE, rate, runtime speedup, RSS or cross-prior equilibrium claim.
acceptance.iterations: Exactly one 560-sweep call per case; no adaptive tuning, retries or discarded samples.
acceptance.quality: Retain exact NashConv and target outcome for every case, including misses. A target miss does not stop later cases.
acceptance.sources: Clean committed source, exact stable revision/status/LF identities before/after every call and overall.

baseline_acceptance.meaning: Exact old-baseline semantic calibration; do not compare adapter/provenance tags or report bytes.

preflight.scope_note: Named training/setup/output loops including 126 additional binary64 mass-sum entries per call, plus separate physical census only. Not total arithmetic, allocated memory, wall time, CPU or RSS bounds.

training_call_counter: Reversible wrapper counts invocations before delegating unchanged shared cfr_plus.train; restored on every exit. Incidental times include instrumentation and are not performance evidence.
